engine: Official native Godot 4.7.2, Arch Linux / Wayland, NVIDIA RTX 3070 Laptop
launch_behavior: Normal launch opens the start screen. Deploy or Enter begins. No automatic shutdown in the launcher.

GPU_benchmark.note: 125-second live autonomous run; passenger-height rear view then camera following dismounted troops. No other test/game instance. Excludes screenshot readbacks and first 3 seconds; does not establish performance at every player viewpoint.

encounter.authored_vehicle_hits: 0–2, conditional on actual occupied arrivals and living launchers

systems: Covered cargo beds with open rears; seated passengers cannot fire or throw grenades
Independent convoy movement, wheel damage, passing attempts and per-truck stuck detection
Conditional final Panzerfaust ambush; no absent-vehicle substitute or invulnerable launchers
Balanced initial left/right assignment, command succession and independent ridge backtracking after the ambush hills
Mission-oriented assault/defense AI with cover reservations, stance changes, suppression and finite supplies
Animated player/AI grenade windup, release and recovery; AI rechecks friendly safety
Toggle crouch and corrected first-person prone boots; slope-aligned NPC prone collision
Gentler graded hills, cached terrain deformation, deeper/wider digging and shallow grenade soil damage
Persistent bodies and breakable weapons; finite pack and grenade limits retained
Batched truck bullet marks, reduced soldier geometry, tree distance limits and cached/throttled AI work
limitations: Original procedural prototype art and simplified animations; not AAA production assets
Finite, budgeted destruction; heightfield pits/trenches but no excavation tunnels or overhangs
Coarse navigation and simple local steering may hesitate around rubble; automated tests do not guarantee AI victory
Convoy casualties and difficulty need human testing; player and allies can die in transit
Recorded GPU sample is not a guarantee for all viewpoints or outcomes
No campaign saves, multiplayer, voice acting or controller mapping
